title: Balances
lede: What each member owes or is owed right now, over the group's open commitments. Nothing here has been settled, and nothing on this screen changes anything.
empty: Nothing is outstanding: this group has no open commitments, so nobody owes anybody anything.

list.cardDescription: One row per member per currency, because a member who holds two currencies has two positions and adding them up needs a rate nobody agreed (ADR 0012). The figures are the plan's own, computed the same way the netting preview computes them.
list.caption: What each member owes or is owed, by currency
list.unnamedNote: A row shown by identifier is either the currency clearing account - the group's own requirement when a commitment crossed currencies, which the response cannot yet label - or a member the group's member list does not name. The identifier is shown rather than a guess.

shared.title: What this group owes
shared.lede: This is a link somebody in the group shared with you. It shows the group's positions - what each member owes or is owed right now - and nothing else: no commitments' memos, no history, and nothing that can change anything.
shared.description: {count} members. One row per member per currency, never summed: adding rupees to yen is not addition.
shared.stamp: Computed at {generated}, and this link works until {expires}.
shared.empty: Nothing is outstanding right now, so there is nothing to show.
shared.caption: What each member owes or is owed, by currency
